wix.title: NEW Riverside
wix.seoTitle: A Day in Riverside | Visit the Host Parish · AC2027 SoCal
wix.seoDesc: Visit Saint Andrew Orthodox Christian Church and seven Riverside landmarks around the Antiochian Archdiocese Convention, July 19–25, 2027 at the Hilton Anaheim.

r: Saint Andrew Orthodox Christian Church is hosting the 2027 Antiochian Archdiocese Convention. Here is how to visit the parish, and seven landmarks of Riverside worth the trip.
Make it a day, not a commute
Riverside is about 35 to 40 miles inland from the Hilton Anaheim: 45 minutes to an hour by car off-peak, mostly on SR-91.
Every Convention event is at the Hilton Anaheim, July 19–25, 2027. Riverside is a day trip for before or after the week, not a place to stay during it. Go early in the day: inland summers are hot.
Saint Andrew, and seven places to see

The host parish’s Byzantine-style temple, modeled on the Church of St. Catherine in Thessaloniki, seats 700 and is finished in marble from seven nations. It was consecrated on December 3, 2011. Visitors are welcome at services: Orthros on Sunday at 9:00 AM and the Divine Liturgy at 10:00 AM. Check

Saint Andrew began with a first Divine Liturgy in a rented room in 1989. Metropolitan PHILIP received it as a mission and named it in 1992, it became a parish in 1997, and the Very Reverend Father Josiah Trenham has been its pastor since 1998.

Riverside’s landmark began in 1876 as a 12-room adobe guest house and grew into a sprawling Mission Revival hotel. It was named a National Historic Landmark in 1977. Walk the courtyards, or stop for a meal.

The Serra Cross on the summit was dedicated in 1907, and the Easter sunrise service held there in 1909 is often called the first of its kind in the country. About three and a half miles of trails climb to views across the city. Go at sunrise in July.
More than 250 acres of working groves tell the story of the citrus industry that built Riverside and Orange County alike. The visitor center is open Friday to Sunday.

At Magnolia and Arlington Avenues stands the tree grown from the navel orange stock sent to Eliza Tibbets in 1873, the start of California’s navel orange industry. It has been a state historical landmark since 1932.
7. The Cheech and the Riverside Art Museum
The Cheech Marin Center for Chicano Art & Culture opened in 2022 in Riverside’s former public library. It is run with the Riverside Art Museum a block away, and one membership covers both.
Mini golf, rides and an arcade in a park that has been a Riverside family favorite since 1976.
A 1929 Spanish Colonial Revival theater, restored and reopened in 2010, a short walk from the Mission Inn. Check the calendar for a show.
Hours and service times change; confirm before you drive. The Convention itself is in Anaheim:
Hilton Anaheim, 777 W Convention Way, Anaheim, CA 92802
$209 a night in the Convention block, July 17–25
